_comment: Hand-written extras for the apps. Every app published by the developer below is found on Google Play by scripts/sync-play.mjs and shown automatically with its Play texts; an entry here only adds what Play cannot know: a curated description (desc + descKey, translated in src/i18n), chips, colour, category, its support answers (faq) and its policy page. status 'unlisted' = not released yet: nothing about it is shown (its policy page stays reachable by its URL, unlinked and noindex) until its pkg appears on Google Play, then it goes live by itself. A live entry that leaves Google Play is shown as unpublished.

faqFamilies.name: Ultimate USB, DROFUS, Ventoy, USB Tools

apps.name: Ultimate USB
apps.desc: The all-in-one USB toolbox. Partition drives with GPT or MBR, format across six file systems, write bootable ISOs, install Ventoy on a drive, image drives byte-by-byte, encrypt drives with a password, and prepare drives for retro gaming consoles — from one app.
apps.headline: Everything a PC does with a USB drive, done from your phone — the all-in-one USB workshop for Android.

features.title: Bootable USB without a PC
features.text: Write Windows 7–11, Linux, macOS (Intel) DMG, Raspberry Pi, FreeDOS and MS-DOS images, with Windows To Go and Linux persistence.

features.title: Multi-boot with Ventoy
features.text: Install Ventoy, then keep many ISOs on one drive and choose at boot — with Secure Boot, MBR or GPT.

features.title: Real disk management
features.text: Format FAT16, FAT32, exFAT, NTFS and ext2/3/4, partition, convert MBR ↔ GPT, and back up or restore whole drives byte by byte.

features.title: Drive health and security
features.text: Find failing sectors and fake-capacity drives, benchmark real speed, wipe securely, and protect drives with a password.

features.title: Retro gaming tools
features.text: PS2 OPL utilities, PS3 ISO tools and a game converter for ISO, CSO, ZSO and CHD.

features.title: Native engine, no root
features.text: Its own C/C++ file-system drivers work over a plain OTG cable. Root is only needed for the internal SD slot.

apps.name: DROFUS — ISO 2 USB
apps.desc: A dedicated bootable-USB creator. Pick an ISO, plug in a drive, and get a bootable installer — no PC and no root required. Full manual control over partition scheme and file system, with Windows 11 requirement bypass and automated setup customization. DROFUS now carries every feature from ISO 2 USB, so it is the one app to install for burning images.
apps.headline: The full-power ISO burner for Android: PC-grade control over every bootable USB, with no PC at all.

features.title: Every major operating system
features.text: Windows 7, 8, 8.1, 10 and 11, modern Linux distributions, macOS DMG (Intel), Raspberry Pi OS and ARM images, FreeDOS and MS-DOS.

features.title: Windows done right
features.text: GPT (UEFI) or MBR (BIOS), NTFS or FAT32, and automatic install.wim splitting for FAT32 — with official Microsoft ISOs, unmodified.

features.title: Windows 11 on more PCs
features.text: Bypass the Windows 11 minimum requirements and automate setup customization for Windows 10 and 11.

features.title: Linux persistence
features.text: Keep your files and changes between boots on distributions that support it.

features.title: Any USB target, no root
features.text: Flash drives, SD card adapters and external SSDs over OTG. Root only for the internal SD slot.

apps.name: Ventoy — Unofficial
apps.desc: Install Ventoy on a USB drive straight from Android. Then just copy as many ISO files as the drive holds — or download them directly to the drive — and pick the one to boot at startup. One drive, every OS installer you need.
apps.headline: Carry every operating system on one USB drive: install Ventoy from your phone, copy ISOs, and choose at boot.

features.title: One drive, many ISOs
features.text: Copy as many ISO files as the drive holds. No reformatting and no reburning, ever.

features.title: Download straight to USB
features.text: Fetch ISO files directly onto the drive from inside the app.

features.title: Boots what you need
features.text: Windows 7–11 and all major Linux distributions, in UEFI or legacy BIOS, with Secure Boot support.

features.title: Full control
features.text: GPT or MBR, exFAT, NTFS or FAT32, Windows 11 requirements bypass, and Ventoy themes and settings without editing files.

apps.name: USB Tools
apps.desc: Maintenance and rescue for flash drives: format, securely wipe with a signed PDF erasure certificate, detect fake-capacity drives, benchmark, defragment, and try to repair corrupted and unreadable drives — without root.
apps.headline: A complete maintenance and rescue kit for USB drives: diagnose, repair, test and securely wipe — from your phone.

features.title: Repair and format
features.text: Try to bring corrupted and unreadable drives back, and format FAT16 to ext4 with MBR or GPT, cluster size and label.

features.title: Catch fake drives
features.text: The bad-blocks scan finds failing sectors and counterfeit capacity on flash drives and SD cards.

features.title: Measure real speed
features.text: Sequential and random read/write benchmarks, plus device info and USB descriptors.

features.title: Secure wipe with certificate
features.text: Erase all data and partitions, and get a signed PDF erasure certificate.

features.title: Backup, defragment, games
features.text: Full drive backup and restore, a FAT32/exFAT defragmenter (needed by PS2 OPL), and PS2/PS3 game tools.

apps.name: USB File Manager
apps.desc: Browse and manage USB flash drives, hard disks and card readers over OTG. Read and write FAT, exFAT, NTFS and ext2/3/4 drives, copy and move files between the phone and the drive, and open or share files with other apps — no root needed for USB drives.
apps.headline: Open any USB drive on Android — NTFS, exFAT, FAT and ext4 — and read and write it without root.

features.title: Every file system
features.text: FAT, exFAT, NTFS and ext2/3/4, read and write, through the app's own native drivers.

features.title: A real file manager
features.text: Copy, move, rename and delete between the phone and the drive, and open or share files with any app.

features.title: Drives of every kind
features.text: Flash drives, card readers, hard disks and SSDs, hubs and drives with several partitions.

features.title: Tabs and two panes
features.text: Open several drives and partitions at once in up to 12 tabs, side by side in two panes, with a queue you can pause, resume or stop.

features.title: Safe by design
features.text: Eject writes out every change before you unplug, and a warning flags drives that may store less than their size says. Root is only needed for the internal SD card slot.

apps.name: ChaoMe Theme Editor
apps.desc: A complete theme studio for Xiaomi devices. Create, customize and install themes on MIUI and HyperOS — icons, wallpapers, fonts, status bar, Control Center — check them against the official theme rules, and export a standard .mtz file. No PC, no root.
apps.headline: A complete theme studio for Xiaomi phones: design, build and install MIUI and HyperOS themes on the phone itself.

features.title: Customize everything
features.text: Icons, icon packs and masks, dynamic calendar and clock icons, wallpapers and lock screen, status bar, notifications, Control Center and volume panel, fonts, contacts, dialer and call screen.

features.title: Live preview
features.text: Every screen shows your changes as you make them.

features.title: Theme check
features.text: Checks a theme against the official theme rules (errors, warnings and store rules) and names the screen that fixes each one. Exports standard .mtz files for MIUI 9 to 14 and HyperOS 1 to 3.

features.title: Clean install without root
features.text: On Android 11 and later, Shizuku puts the theme into Themes → My themes. Shizuku is optional: without it, the app still builds and exports .mtz files.

features.title: Edit or start fresh
features.text: Open an installed theme to change it, start from a Light or Dark template, or build one from scratch.

features.title: Theme library
features.text: Every theme you build is kept in a library on the phone: search it, compare two themes, reuse single parts, and back it up to a zip file.

apps.name: TumTum
apps.desc: A calm sliding puzzle with one rule: when you swipe, every character on the board moves at once. 1,100 handmade levels across 110 chapters, undo and hints whenever you need them, and it plays fully offline. Free with ads, and no in-app purchases.
apps.headline: A cozy puzzle built on one brilliant rule — one swipe moves everyone — with 1,100 handmade levels to master.

features.title: One rule, endless depth
features.text: Every character slides until it hits something. Pits, spikes, crates, breakable blocks, one-way tiles, springs and belts keep it fresh.

features.title: 1,100 handcrafted levels
features.text: 110 chapters, and every level checked by hand for a clean, fair solution.

features.title: Zero pressure
features.text: No timers and no lives. Undo, restart or take a hint whenever you like.

features.title: Original art and music
features.text: Hand-drawn characters that each move their own way, and soft music made for the game.

features.title: Fair by design
features.text: Free, with no in-app purchases. Plays fully offline, in 11 languages.

apps.name: MixDocs
apps.desc: Open, edit, convert and scan documents — PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and OpenDocument — with text recognition, all on your device.
apps.headline: Open, edit, convert, scan and sign your documents in one app: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and more than 50 file types. Everything is processed on your phone, and every tool is free, with no page limits, no watermarks and no account.

features.title: Every document opens
features.text: PDF, Office and OpenDocument files in their original layout, plus Pages, Numbers, Keynote, e-books, comics, e-mail and images. Search, bookmarks, night mode and reflowed text make reading easy.

features.title: Edit PDF and Office
features.text: Highlight, draw, add notes and edit text and pictures in a PDF, and fill in forms. Write documents, work with formulas in spreadsheets, and present slides.

features.title: Convert and organize
features.text: PDF to Word, Excel, PowerPoint, EPUB or images, and many files to PDF at once. Merge, split, rotate and compress; recipes run several steps on many files.

features.title: Scan and recognize
features.text: Scan pages and ID cards, turn photos into text and searchable PDFs, and read QR codes and barcodes. Translate documents and listen to them read aloud, or save them as audio.

features.title: Sign and protect
features.text: Sign by hand or with a digital signature, lock a PDF with a password, black out text so it is gone for good, and remove hidden data before you share.

features.title: Private, with Pro once
features.text: Your documents never leave your phone: no account and no cloud. Every tool is free with ads; a one-time Pro purchase removes all ads and lets MixDocs work offline.

apps.name: MixMedia
apps.desc: Compress, convert, trim and merge video, audio and photos, make GIFs and handle subtitles, all on your device.

apps.name: Cofferlock
apps.desc: A private vault for your photos, videos and files, which never leave your phone. Fingerprint unlock, 12 recovery words, and one vault file you can back up anywhere.
apps.headline: Keep your private photos, videos and documents locked in one vault that only you can open. It works like a normal file manager, and your files never leave your phone. No account and no cloud.

features.title: One vault, one file
features.text: Your whole vault is one locked file. Keep it in any folder you like; to back it up, just copy that file.

features.title: Strong protection
features.text: Strong encryption locks every file: even someone who copies the vault file cannot read it without your password. If an import stops halfway, the vault is not damaged, and a built-in tool repairs a damaged vault.

features.title: Unlock your way
features.text: Your password or your fingerprint. Forgot your password? 12 recovery words open your vault.

features.title: A real file manager
features.text: Folders, previews, search, filters and selecting many files at once. Open files in your usual apps, and no unlocked copy is left behind.

features.title: Private by design
features.text: No account, no cloud, no ads, no tracking. It locks by itself, blocks screenshots and shows every unlock and every failed try. Free with a vault of up to 5 GB.

features.title: Pro: pay once
features.text: Unlimited space and more vaults, a decoy vault, encrypted Trash, one-tap backup, sealed envelopes and adding files from any app's Share menu. No subscription.

apps.name: ISO 2 USB
apps.desc: The original ISO burner. Every feature it had now lives in DROFUS, alongside everything added since.

apps.name: MultiOS-USB — Unofficial
apps.desc: Multi-boot USB setup built around the open-source MultiOS-USB project.
